Title: Lok Easy Hype
Description:
The Easy Hype is an attacking Lok racket for intermediate players. It adapts to most playing styles but puts the emphasis on attack, so it suits players who like to move forward and finish points at the net while still wanting a comfortable feel.

The diamond shape and raised sweet spot give it an offensive character, while the mixed carbon fibre surface keeps the touch comfortable. Lok's asymmetric heart optimises weight distribution for manoeuvrability and stability, giving quicker, more precise responses. The Gradual Face system uses steps and reliefs on the face to reduce vibration on impact, and extra carbon layers at key points of the frame add rigidity and durability. It also comes with Lok's adjustable Comfort Wristband.

  • Shape: diamond with a raised sweet spot
  • Weight: 351 to 375 g

  • Asymmetric heart

The AT10 Pro balances speed, stability and comfort, and has become one of the most popular models in the Nox range. It suits intermediate and advanced players who want a secure, firm feel on explosive movements. This pair is turquoise blue with small white details.

A technical mesh upper with a TPU structure ventilates well and adds support, while a rubber toe cap and external heel reinforcement protect against wear. Underfoot, a Strobel construction with popcorn-type EVA and a low-density injected phylon midsole gives soft, reactive cushioning, and an Ortholite insole adds comfort. The herringbone sole with micro studs grips well, and Lateral Support widens the contact area for stability.

  • Strobel construction with popcorn-type EVA and low-density injected phylon midsole
  • Ortholite insole
  • Herringbone sole with micro studs
  • Lateral Support and AGG technologies

The Astrum+ 2026 is a versatile teardrop for advanced players who want a balance of control, power and comfort. The teardrop head gives a good mix of power and precision, and combined with the 12K Carbon Hyper surface it widens the sweet spot, so shots stay solid when you are stretched.

The M-Eva Balance core gives good shock absorption and stability, and the 12K carbon face keeps the response crisp and durable. It is an all-round racket for players who mix powerful overheads with softer drop shots and want one racket that handles both. At around 370 g it feels stable on contact, and the balanced setup keeps it comfortable through long matches.

The Hybrid Fly 26I belongs to Bullpadel's Fastlab line, which prioritises one thing above all: speed. Bullpadel rates it 5 out of 5 for speed, 3 for stability and 2.5 for cushioning, so it suits players who base their game on quick movement and want a light shoe that gets them to every ball.

The hybrid sole works on all types of synthetic court and includes the ROTOX system, an integrated rotation disc that helps you pivot quickly. The X-Tra Base system adds lateral stability, and the breathable mesh upper keeps the build light and cool. There is no associated player; it is designed purely for speed. Sizing is standard, so take your usual size. This colourway is black.

  • Fastlab line, FW26 season
  • Hybrid sole with ROTOX rotation disc
  • X-Tra Base lateral stability
  • Breathable mesh upper
  • Standard sizing; brand ratings: speed 5, stability 3, cushioning 2.5

Description:
The M27 Light 2026 is a light, versatile version of Royal Padel's M27, for players who want to excel in defence but keep the comfort and power needed to move forward and attack. It is one of the most balanced, comfortable rackets in the range.

The round shape provides a large, centred sweet spot that favours control, while the medium balance helps connection on aerial balls and adds the extra power you need on attacks. A soft, high-density polyethylene core gives a comfortable feel, and the 100% 3K carbon faces add precision and durability. At 350 to 365 g it is more manoeuvrable and quicker in changes of pace, and it reduces fatigue in long matches.
